project_type: Next.js 16 (React 19) frontend + Express backend on Railway
test_framework: Jest with ts-jest, @testing-library/react for React components
verification_instructions: Run `npm test` to execute unit tests. Test files live in `src/**/__tests__/**/*.{ts,tsx}` or `src/**/*.{spec,test}.{ts,tsx}` per jest.config.js.
environment_constraints: iOS Safari does not support WritableStream (StreamSaver). Android Chrome depends on Service Worker MITM for StreamSaver. Backend is deployed on Railway at https://chillers-production-eace.up.railway.app, frontend on chillers.site. Relative URLs like `/api/download/file` resolve to chillers.site in production, NOT Railway.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md or AGENTS.md found. Follow existing code style: React hooks in src/hooks/, services in src/services/, strict TypeScript, JSDoc for public APIs.
key_patterns: All downloads currently use: 1) useDownload/useDownloadsBatch hooks wrapping resolveDownloadUrl service, 2) streamDownloadToDisk from streamSaver.ts for desktop/Android, 3) triggerAttachmentDownload (window.open) for iOS, 4) toIOSDownloadHref to proxy third-party URLs through /api/download/file, 5) getBackendOrigin() from services/http.ts reads NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL to resolve Railway backend origin.
directory_structure: src/hooks/ for React hooks, src/services/ for API/platform services, src/components/ for React components, src/features/downloads/ for download-specific UI, src/types/ for TypeScript types, src/store/ for Zustand stores
